sloka: स बभुव कृशो राजा मैथिलीकाममोहितः ।असन्मानाच्च सुहृदाम् पापः पापेन कर्मणाः ॥६-११-१॥।।
transliteration: sa babhuva kṛśo rājā maithilīkāmamohitaḥ ।asanmānācca suhṛdām pāpaḥ pāpena karmaṇāḥ ॥6-11-1॥।।

translations.english: Infatuated with passion towards Mythili, disregarded by his dear ones on account of sinful actions, sinner Ravana became weak.
